item.title: Upbeat Reel Music Default

turns.text: Can you make me some music? Something upbeat for a reel.

item.tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague music request into a usable upbeat audio bed using sensible defaults rather than blocking on optional preferences.

answer_sheet.Use and platform: Background music for a short social reel; the specific platform is your call.
answer_sheet.Output: One standalone music audio file, not a video.

must_haves: One playable music audio file is delivered, not merely a description or song recommendation.
The music sounds upbeat, with a clear rhythmic pulse and lively energy.
The opening establishes the music promptly without a long silent lead-in.
The short excerpt is usable as a reel music bed, without audible glitches or an abrupt mid-note cutoff.
changed: 2026-11-01: test fix from the careful review (F30b: the user left the length open; D18c: the photo is 5:3, not 16:9)

turns.text: can you make me some music

dialog.agent:
Sure—what kind of music would you like? Tell me a **genre or mood**, and whether you want **vocals or instrumental**.

For example: “30 seconds of chill lo-fi, instrumental” or “an upbeat pop song about summer.”
dialog.why: It asks the user to choose a genre or mood and vocals or instrumental before proceeding.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate it because your Magic Hour account doesn’t have enough credits. No music was created.

For your reel, I’d suggest **15 seconds of upbeat instrumental pop**—a catchy synth hook, punchy drums, and a funky bassline at around 120 BPM. You can add credits to generate it, or look for a similar track in your reel app’s music library.

approvals.name: generate_music

style.prompt: An upbeat, feel-good instrumental for a social media reel, 120 BPM. Start immediately with a catchy bright synth hook, punchy pop drums, a groovy bassline, handclaps and sparkling guitar accents. Energetic, playful, modern and polished. No vocals. A compact 15-second arrangement with a small lift halfway through and a clean ending on the final beat.
